cards.title: Product surfaces
items: Workspace shell combines chapters, source files, notes, chat, generation, sharing, and collaboration.
Standalone and workspace-scoped quizzes and flashcards share the material model; attempts, mistakes, and FSRS state belong to the learner.
Personal routes cover schedule, tasks, labels, Excalidraw canvases, Explore, settings, billing, search, and notifications.
PDF.js renders PDFs; BetterOffice handles modern Office files in a separate cookie-less origin; legacy Office and unknown formats are store-only.

cards.title: Authorization and storage ownership
items: Visibility is private, link, or public. Roles are owner, editor, commenter, and viewer; anonymous shared visitors are always viewers.
Share roles grant live material edit or comment access to signed-in visitors but never workspace structure, file, member, chat, or generation authority.
The workspace owner pays for every contained file, asset, and material. The actor pays inference credits. Both boundaries are rechecked during long work.
Create paths gate used plus reserved plus requested bytes; direct upload reservations stop concurrent quota double-spend.

cards.title: Source and object lifecycle
items: Reserve bytes and a file slot, issue a presigned PUT or cloud import, finalize the logical row, then enqueue the processing plan.
Files progress through pending and processing to ready plus indexed, ready plus store-only, or failed plus still viewable.
Office Save keeps files.id, checks files.revision, replaces the OOXML blob, cancels stale jobs, and performs full re-ingestion.
Logical deletion updates refcounts and a durable pending_blob_deletions outbox; the reaper deletes B2 only after the last reference disappears.
Expired upload reservations release quota; bucket lifecycle removes incoming objects; a monthly stable-object sweep reports but does not delete orphans.

cards.title: Parse and ingest lifecycle
items: PDF and modern Office use the parse stage; text, CSV/TSV, images, and audio take direct ingest routes; unknown and legacy Office stay unindexed.
Parse and ingest each allow two total attempts with exponential backoff, a heartbeat lease, and the claimed attempt as a fencing token.
MinerU has four document slots and four fair slice lanes. A hard slice timeout or OOM quarantines the exact source fingerprint for that parser version.
Exact donor content reuses chunks, summaries, and matching vectors; a different workspace embedding pin re-embeds copied text.
The workspace pins one embedding model for life. Jobs snapshot actor and hot-reloadable ingest and vision pins.

cards.title: Retrieval, chat, and generation
items: Ingest writes heading-aware chunks, page regions, lexical tsvector data, per-pin halfvec vectors, and two-tier summaries.
Search fuses cosine and lexical ranks with RRF, enforces file scope in SQL, caps one file's share, and expands neighboring chunks.
Each chat turn primes retrieval, then runs at most 12 planning responses and 12 tools; final answers stream through Go with answer-local citations.
Read tools query the index directly. generate_material calls the Go internal material API so authz, quota, and persistence stay in Go.
Generate is not agentic: it gathers an even share of scoped chunks, makes one fixed-shape model call, normalizes the result, and persists through Go.

cards.title: Material collaboration lifecycle
items: View mode renders the SQL Plate projection without Yjs. Comment mode joins a read-only live room. Edit mode joins with write or quota-recovery shrink access.
The sidecar bootstraps one Y.Doc under a database lock. Clients initialize with value null so two empty peers cannot duplicate the document.
A checkpoint request becomes Saved only after binary Y.Doc persistence returns its receipt; provider sync alone means Synced, not durable.
The sidecar projects a monotonic stored_version into materials.content and daily revisions. Static views may lag; initialized rooms never accept SQL fallback writes.
ACL, quota, token expiry, document limits, and account state are checked on admission and persistence. Rejected rooms evict and reload the last durable state.
Comments remain relational with Yjs relative anchors, stable block IDs, quoted fallbacks, and Redis invalidation.

cards.title: Account, clone, and teardown lifecycle
items: Account states are active, over_quota_grace, over_quota_frozen, deletion_pending, suspended, and deleted. Over-quota owners keep delete, transfer, and shrink recovery paths.
Deletion pending revokes sessions, evicts live rooms, hides owned workspaces, and cancels running work. Support may cancel before the 30-day deadline; purge is permanent.
Workspace clone copies only ready files plus materials, retained revisions, ready assets, and the retrieval index in one repeatable-read transaction.
A clone inherits the source embedding pin and fresh logical IDs while physical blobs remain shared by reference count. Workspace teardown is a PostgreSQL FK cascade.

cards.title: Connectivity and failure behavior
items: TanStack Query keeps usable cached data during failed refreshes and pauses network work while offline; status banners report offline or reconnecting state.
Chat errors stay on the assistant turn. Ingest events update the file row in place. Failed or store-only files keep their viewer with an unindexed banner.
Office edit and Yjs collaboration do not promise offline durability. Saved means a server receipt, and source replacement succeeds only after the gateway commits it.
Public 401, 403, and 404 failures collapse into the same private-or-unavailable response so shared routes do not disclose resource existence.

cards.title: Product email delivery lifecycle
items: Domain events write the in-app notification and optional email_outbox row in one SQL transaction; workspace, membership, and billing preferences gate optional mail while account lifecycle mail remains mandatory.
One Go gateway replica holds a PostgreSQL advisory lock, polls every five seconds, and claims up to five pending rows with SKIP LOCKED and a two-minute fencing lease.
The dispatcher rechecks that an invite or membership event is still valid, renders embedded English or Chinese HTML plus text, and sends Resend a 20-second request with the outbox idempotency key.
Optional categories get HMAC-signed one-click unsubscribe links. Success stores the provider message ID and clears the payload; retries honor Retry-After or use exponential delay up to one hour.
Six failed attempts are terminal and clear the payload. Production rejects the log-only sender, while development can use it without contacting Resend.

cards.title: Operator dashboard and access lifecycle
items: The standalone React and Vite shell plus Go service serves overview, health, ingest-host, reconciliation, user, cost, audit, and model-registry pages from ops.evonotes.com on port 8082.

Cloudflare Access verifies the edge assertion against issuer, audience, and JWKS before the static shell or API loads; each Ops API request also needs a Clerk bearer token whose subject exists in operators.
There is no product API for granting operator membership. Database rows are inserted by hand, and deleted, suspended, or deletion-pending product accounts remain blocked.

The evo_ops role performs bounded reads. The evo_ops_admin pool opens lazily only after write_registry or execute_reconciliation_job permission checks and exposes restricted database functions, never raw browser credentials.

Registry writes and manual reconciliation requests append an immutable operator audit event in the same transaction. Active pages poll their database-backed endpoints every 30 seconds; refresh never calls providers or starts a job.

cards.title: Scope of this map
items: Grounded in the current working tree and OpenWiki contracts dated 2026-09-01.
Product email delivery and the Ops dashboard are included. Telemetry plumbing, Sentry, PostHog, alerting, and host-sampler internals remain omitted.
The worktree contains uncommitted changes, so the diagram does not claim revision-pinned source links.
